slice.title: Cross-section
slice.planeHelp: Drag the blue handle in the 3D view, or use the offset slider to move the cutting plane.

volume.title: 3D orbital
volume.help: Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate. Plus and minus zoom. Azimuth and elevation sliders also rotate the view.
volume.orbitDescription: Rotate the focused 3D view with the Left, Right, Up and Down arrow keys.
volume.zoomDescription: Zoom the focused 3D view with the plus or minus key.
volume.probeHelp: Move the radial cursor and highlight the corresponding spherical shell in the 3D view. Zero hides the shell.

angularDetail.title: Angular probability density
angularDetail.description: Polar section at φ = {{phi}}°. Radius shows angular density, normalized to its peak. This is density per solid angle, without the sin θ integration weight.

mobile.help: Use the scroll bar, wheel, or swipe outside controls. Down Arrow scrolls down; Up Arrow scrolls up. Keyboard focus brings controls into view.

screenSummary.playArea: Explore the orbital as a volume, probability dots, or a 90% or 95% isosurface. The radial chart shares a probe with the 3D view. The cross-section shows the selected cutting plane.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose quantum numbers, real or complex angular functions, charge, rendering mode and stationary-state presets. Toggle 3D or slice nodes. Camera sliders, the radial probe slider and the plane offset slider provide keyboard control.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change n, l and m to see how the orbital's size, shape and nodes change. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate. Plus and minus zoom. Azimuth and elevation sliders also rotate the view.

orbitals.currentDetails: {{state}} of {{ion}}. Energy {{energy}} electronvolts. Mean radius {{radius}} {{unit}}. {{radialNodes}} radial nodes and {{angularNodes}} angular nodes. {{nodeDetails}}

controls.principalHelp: From 1 to 5. Sets the energy and the overall size of the orbital.
controls.orbitalHelp: From 0 to n minus 1. Sets the shape and the number of angular nodes.
controls.magneticHelp: From minus l to l. Sets the orientation, or how fast the phase winds around the z-axis.
controls.nuclearChargeHelp: Larger charge pulls the electron closer; the orbital shrinks as one over Z.
controls.offsetHelp: Moves the cross-section along the axis perpendicular to it.
controls.complexBasis: Complex spherical harmonics Y l m
controls.realBasis: Real orbitals such as p x and d x y

screenSummary.playArea: The 3D view shows a coherent superposition. The graph tracks mean radius and mean z position over time.
screenSummary.controlArea: Mix up to six hydrogenic states using quantum numbers, coefficient magnitudes and phases. Choose a preset, rendering mode, charge and playback speed.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Play, pause or step through time. Arrow keys rotate the focused 3D view; plus and minus zoom. Sliders provide keyboard equivalents.

superposition.currentDetails: {{count}} distinct occupied states. Time {{time}} femtoseconds. Mean z {{z}} {{unit}} and mean radius {{r}} {{unit}}.

screenSummary.playArea: The diagram shows angular-momentum vectors, precession cones and allowed projections. The polar plot shows angular probability density.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose l and m, or include spin and choose j and its projection. Play or step the schematic precession, or adjust its phase with the slider.
screenSummary.interactionHint: The vectors are a quantum vector-model illustration. Precession speed is illustrative.

angularMomentum.currentDetails: l = {{l}}; m = {{m}}; j = {{j}}; mⱼ = {{mj}}. Magnitudes in ℏ: L={{L}}, S={{S}}, J={{J}}. Orbital ΔLₓ ΔLᵧ / ℏ²={{uncertainty}}; a dash means not applicable.

screenSummary.playArea: The diagram shows magnetic sublevels grouped by l and j, labelled with their zero-field energies. Lines show transitions from the selected upper level. The spectrum shows positions of all allowed transitions.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose normal or anomalous splitting, spectral series, charge, magnetic field, viewing direction and upper level. Play or step the schematic Larmor precession.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Along the magnetic field, only sigma components are visible. The anomalous mode restricts the field to its labelled weak-field cap.

zeeman.currentDetails: Field {{field}} tesla, cap {{cap}} tesla. {{count}} distinct spectral positions. Wavelength range {{minimum}} to {{maximum}} nm. Selected upper state: {{state}}.

screenSummary.playArea: The 3D view shows oscillator states in reduced coordinates. The overlap matrix compares the Cartesian and spherical bases. Rows are Cartesian; columns are spherical.
screenSummary.controlArea: Choose shell N, the rendered basis and a state in each basis. Row and column selectors highlight one overlap coefficient. Rotate, zoom or select volume or isosurface rendering.
screenSummary.interactionHint: The overlap matrix uses colour strength for squared magnitude. The complex coefficient is read separately. The two bases span the same degenerate energy shell.

superposition.empty: The coefficients cancel. Choose a nonzero state.
superposition.stationary: Stationary density: all occupied states share one energy.
superposition.normalization: The combined state is normalized automatically. Dots are probability samples, not trajectories.

angular.title: Quantum angular momentum
angular.densityHelp: Radius shows density per solid angle, normalized to its peak. Spin mode traces over spin.
angular.note: Schematic quantum vector model; animation speed is illustrative. These vectors are not electron trajectories.

zeeman.centred: Each l,j group is centred on its labelled zero-field energy; shifts are magnified.
zeeman.cap: Weak-field cap: largest magnetic shift ≤ 5% of the smallest fine-structure gap.
zeeman.capHelp: The slider spans zero to the labelled cap. Changing mode, line or charge changes that cap.
zeeman.note: Line positions only; intensities, Lamb and hyperfine shifts omitted. Precession animation speed is illustrative.

oscillator.note: Columns: (nᵣ,l,m); rows: (nₓ,nᵧ,n_z). Oscillator SU(3), hydrogen SO(4). Isosurface: approximately 90%.
